question:
Transparency International has released the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2021.

What is the rank of India in this index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**85th.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** has been ranked** 85th **in the **Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2021.**
 
• CPI is an annual survey conducted by** Transparency International** that ranks countries based on their perceived levels of public sector corruption.
 
• The index ranks countries on a scale of **0 to 100,** with** 0 being highly corrupt **and **100 being very clean.**
 
• The rankings are based on **expert assessments and surveys** of business people conducted by various organizations.
 
• The CPI is widely used by governments, NGOs, and businesses to assess the l**evel of corruption** in different countries and to formulate** anti-corruption policies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the** 2022 Corruption Perceptions Index,** India was ranked **40 out of 180 nations **by Transparency International.
 
• **"Abuse of entrusted power for private gain" **is the general definition of corruption according to the CPI.
 
• Transparency International, a non-governmental organization, has been publishing the index every year since **1995. **
